items.title: Infect the Grid
items.placementTarget: Rulebook page 8, slot D (replaces setup step 4, Infect the Grid)
items.text:
[4 in a red circle] INFECT THE GRID
Shuffle the Infection cards and flip over 6 of them. Move 1 Supply cube from the city matching each flipped card back to the stockpile. If a card is flipped over and there are no supply cubes in the city, instead place a Plague cube and move the Incident marker forward 1 space on the Incident track.
Flip 3 more Infection cards. For each card, place 1 Hollow Men figure in the matching city.
Place these 9 cards into the Infection discard pile.

rules: Setup step 4 starts by shuffling the Infection cards.
Flip 6 cards. Each one returns 1 supply cube from that city to the stockpile.
If that city has no supply cubes, place 1 plague cube there and advance the Incident marker 1 space instead.
Flip 3 more Infection cards. Place 1 Hollow Men figure in each matching city.
All 9 flipped cards go to the Infection discard pile.
mechanics.effect: Replaces the original nine-flip cube strip with a 6-cube strip plus 3 Hollow Men placements.

summary: Replaces setup step 4. Six infection flips strip one supply cube (or add a plague and advance the incident track). Three more flips each place one Hollow Men figure. All nine cards go to the infection discard.
